mentions.name: Fronteer
mentions.description: This app is a project management tool that integrates messaging cohesively with tasks and better supports collaborating with external collaborators such as agency clients and customers. It is currently in private beta with plans to open to the general public.
mentions.problem: Chat is often separate from a solid task manager, and collaborating with people outside your own organization is painful.
mentions.audience: Teams collaborating with external partners such as agency clients and customers
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Fronteer, a project management app that (1) integrates messaging more cohesively with tasks and (2) better supports external collaborators - think agency clients, customers, etc.

evidence.value: Working on Fronteer, a project management app that (1) integrates messaging more cohesively with tasks and (2) better supports external collaborators - think agency clients, customers, etc.
